lines.en: label ramen5:
scene tsuneysecondramen1
I enter the ramen shop to be greeted by yet another blank stare from none other than the Kendo princess of whatever.
lines.zh: 我走进拉面店，迎面又是那位不知所谓的剑道公主的一个白眼。

lines.en: I’ve never been good with nicknames.
lines.zh: 我向来不擅长起外号。

lines.en: : Good evening. Welcome to Tojo Ramen.
lines.zh: : 晚上好。欢迎光临 Tojo Ramen。

lines.en: : Please take your time looking over the menu and let me know if you have any questions.
lines.zh: : 请慢慢看菜单，有什么问题随时告诉我。

lines.en: : That’s exactly what you say every time I come here.
lines.zh: : 你每次我来都这么说。

lines.en: : Please let me know if you have any questions.
lines.zh: : 有什么问题随时告诉我。

lines.en: : I don’t have any questions, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 我没有问题，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : Then let me know when you are ready to order.
lines.zh: : 那你想好点什么的时候告诉我。

lines.en: : Woah. Where’s your normal “Ah-” that happens almost every time I say your name? I was just starting to get used to it.
lines.zh: : 哇。你平时每次听到我叫你名字都会「啊——」一声，去哪儿了？我都快习惯了。

lines.en: : I must have forgotten.
lines.zh: : 我大概是忘了。

lines.en: : Are you sure you’re not just getting comfortable around me?
lines.zh: : 你确定不是跟我在一起变得自在了？

lines.en: : Is there a reason for me to be uncomfortable?
lines.zh: : 我有理由不自在吗？

lines.en: : Well, yeah. I’m an older guy and you’re a girl. Doesn’t that sort of thing happen naturally?
lines.zh: : 嗯，有啊。我是个年纪更大的男人，你是个女孩。这种事不是自然而然的吗？

lines.en: : Does it?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : I am alone with my father often and have never once felt uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 我经常和父亲单独相处，从来没有觉得不自在过。

lines.en: : Well that’s your father. It’s different.
lines.zh: : 可那是你父亲。不一样。

lines.en: : I don’t understand how.
lines.zh: : 我不明白哪里不一样。

lines.en: : We are all humans.
lines.zh: : 我们都是人类。

lines.en: : Man. Woman. Child. Dog.
lines.zh: : 男人。女人。小孩。狗。

lines.en: : We all breathe air and we all eat noodles.
lines.zh: : 我们都呼吸空气，都吃面条。

lines.en: : Such is life.
lines.zh: : 人生就是这样。

lines.en: : Once again, I think your philosophical side is falling a bit short.
lines.zh: : 又一次，我觉得你那哲学的一面有点站不住脚。

lines.en: : I’ll get it one day.
lines.zh: : 总有一天我会搞懂的。

lines.en: : Also, I’m not sure if I have to actually remind you this or not, but dogs don’t count as humans.
lines.zh: : 还有，我不确定要不要真的提醒你，狗不算人类。

lines.en: : They should.
lines.zh: : 它们应该算。

lines.en: scene tsuneysecondramen2
: Have you ever had a dog, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你养过狗吗？

lines.en: : I did when I was younger.
lines.zh: : 我小时候养过。

lines.en: : ...Please tell me that you didn’t snap its neck and serve it to customers.
lines.zh: : ……请别告诉我你扭断了它的脖子，然后端给客人吃。

lines.en: scene tsuneysecondramen3
: Disgusting.
lines.zh: : 恶心。

lines.en: : You should be ashamed of yourself for even thinking that.
lines.zh: : 你该为自己有这种念头感到羞耻。

lines.en: : He was killed humanely and not served to anyone. He’s buried several blocks from here in an empty lot.
lines.zh: : 它被安乐死了，也没端给任何人。它埋在离这儿几个街区外的一块空地上。

lines.en: : Oh. Uhh...Sorry for your loss?
lines.zh: : 哦。呃……节哀？

lines.en: : I’m not really sure how to follow up to a spontaneous reveal like that.
lines.zh: : 我真不知道该怎么接这种突如其来的坦白。

lines.en: scene tsuneysecondramen2
: It’s okay. Sickness gets to everyone eventually.
lines.zh: : 没关系。疾病最终会找上每个人。

lines.en: : Just as I’m sure it will claim you and I someday.
lines.zh: : 就像我敢肯定，总有一天它也会带走你和我。

lines.en: : That’s less philosophical and more depressing. I give it a 6/10.
lines.zh: : 这与其说哲学，不如说让人沮丧。我给 6/10。

lines.en: : A passing grade. I accept.
lines.zh: : 及格了。我接受。

lines.en: Tsuneyo begins to fidget with something behind her back, adjusting her shoulders so I can’t see whatever it is she’s holding.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 开始在背后摆弄什么东西，挪动肩膀，好让我看不见她拿着的是什么。

lines.en: But knowing her, I imagine it’s some sort of noodle-related paraphernalia.
lines.zh: 不过按她的性格，我猜是某种和面条有关的器具。

lines.en: : Are you hiding something from me, Tsuneyo?
lines.zh: : 你在藏什么东西吗，Tsuneyo？

lines.en: scene tsuneysecondramen1
: Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : I’m hiding many things from you. It is common nature to not open up right away to someone you don’t know or trust.
lines.zh: : 我对你藏了很多东西。对一个你不认识、不信任的人，不立刻敞开心扉是人之常情。

lines.en: : No, like literally hiding something. Behind your back.
lines.zh: : 不是，我是说字面意义上的藏东西。在你背后。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Yes.
: Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : ...Can I see it?
lines.zh: : ……能给我看看吗？

lines.en: : Sure.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: scene tsuneysecondramen4
Tsuneyo brings the object she was hiding into view and it is...a large chef’s knife.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 把她藏着的东西亮了出来，那是一把……大厨刀。

lines.en: : Prepare to die, you bastard.
lines.zh: : 受死吧，你这混蛋。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, would you mind explaining to me why you were hiding a knife behind your back this entire time?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，你能解释一下为什么你从头到尾都在背后藏一把刀吗？

lines.en: : It will be a boring explanation.
lines.zh: : 这个解释会很无聊。

lines.en: : Would you like to hear it anyway?
lines.zh: : 你还想听吗？

lines.en: : Yes, please. I’d like to confirm that I can still come here without the risk of being murdered.
lines.zh: : 想，请说。我想确认一下，我以后还能不能来这儿而不被谋杀。

lines.en: : You walked in while I was cutting ingredients and I forgot to put it down.
lines.zh: : 你进来的时候我正在切配料，忘了把刀放下。

lines.en: : By the time you got to the counter, I realized I was still holding it and hid it behind my back so you wouldn’t think I was going to kill you.
lines.zh: : 等你走到柜台前，我才意识到自己还拿着它，就藏到背后，好让你不觉得我要杀你。

lines.en: : Oh. That actually {i}is{/i} a boring explanation.
lines.zh: : 哦。这解释{i}确实{/i}挺无聊的。

lines.en: : I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: : But wait. Then what was with that “Prepare to die, you bastard” line?
lines.zh: : 可是等等。那你那句「受死吧，你这混蛋」是怎么回事？

lines.en: : Why would you say that if you didn’t want me to think you were going to kill me?
lines.zh: : 如果你不想让我以为你要杀我，为什么要那么说？

lines.en: : I thought it would help create a more fun atmosphere for the ramen shop.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那样能给拉面店营造出更有趣的氛围。

lines.en: : I can see it now. People flocking in from all over the world because of the quirky, upbeat ramen girl, Tsuneyo Tojo.
lines.zh: : 我已经能看到那一天了——人们从世界各地涌来，就为了见那个古灵精怪、元气满满的拉面女孩 Tsuneyo Tojo。

lines.en: : Quirky and upbeat are perhaps two of the only words I would {i}not{/i} use to describe you.
lines.zh: : 「古灵精怪」和「元气满满」，大概是我最{i}不会{/i}用来形容你的两个词。

lines.en: : Then I will have to end your life.
lines.zh: : 那我就只能取你性命了。

lines.en: : Prepare to die at the hands of the flavor-samurai.
lines.zh: : 在风味武士手下受死吧。

lines.en: : Can I at least have one last bowl of ramen before I pass on?
lines.zh: : 我临死前至少能吃上最后一碗拉面吧？

lines.en: scene tsuneysecondramen5
: Of course. A death is not truly honorable unless you are full of noodles.
lines.zh: : 当然。不塞满面条的死亡，算不上真正有尊严的死亡。

lines.en: Despite these one liners and philosophies (If you even want to call them that) making absolutely no sense, they’re definitely...amusing.
lines.zh: 尽管这些俏皮话和哲理（如果那也能叫哲理的话）完全没有逻辑，它们确实……挺逗的。

lines.en: It’s actually kind of impressive how horrible Tsuneyo is at communicating.
lines.zh: 其实 Tsuneyo 沟通差到这种地步，反倒有点了不起。

lines.en: Either that or she’s actually way better at it than she lets on and is simply pulling my leg in every single conversation.
lines.zh: 要么就是她其实比表现出来的强得多，每次聊天都在耍我。

lines.en: Maybe she’s some sort of super genius and I’m just not aware of it?
lines.zh: 也许她是个超级天才，只是我没察觉？

lines.en: : What? Why are you looking at me like that?
lines.zh: : 怎么？你干嘛那样看我？

lines.en: : I’m waiting for your order.
lines.zh: : 我在等你点单。

lines.en: : It is your last meal, so I will make sure it is one to remember.
lines.zh: : 这是你的最后一餐，所以我会让它成为值得铭记的一餐。

lines.en: : Even if you won't actually get to remember it.
lines.zh: : 尽管你其实没机会记住它了。

lines.en: : Wait, you’re not actually going to kill me, are you?
lines.zh: : 等等，你不会真要杀我吧？

lines.en: : You have insulted the integrity of the Tojo family. I must do my job and uphold it by any means possible.
lines.zh: : 你侮辱了 Tojo 家的尊严。我必须尽一切手段维护它。

lines.en: : How can you say something so serious with a smile on your face?
lines.zh: : 你怎么能面带微笑说出这么严肃的话？

lines.en: : Because I’m joking.
lines.zh: : 因为我在开玩笑。

lines.en: : Really? You kept this one going for so long that I was beginning to think you might actually be serious.
lines.zh: : 真的？你把这个玩笑拖了这么久，我都开始以为你是认真的了。

lines.en: : Killing a customer during store hours would lead to bad reviews.
lines.zh: : 营业时间杀死客人会导致差评。

lines.en: : We’d need to create a new tag line just to get the restaurant back on track.
lines.zh: : 我们得想一条新的宣传语，才能让餐馆重回正轨。

lines.en: scene tsuneysecondramen6
: Tojo Ramen. All of the flavor, none of the violence.
lines.zh: : Tojo Ramen。风味俱全，零暴力。

lines.en: : Something like that.
lines.zh: : 大概是这样的。

lines.en: : What a totally inconspicuous slogan for a store where the Yakuza hang out.
lines.zh: : 对一家山口组常来的店来说，这口号可真够低调的。

lines.en: scene tsuneysecondramen5
: Real estate is not a violent business, Sensei. You should know this if you are going to teach people.
lines.zh: : Sensei，房地产不是暴力行当。你要是还想教人，就该知道这一点。

lines.en: : I lack any sort of formal education and even I know that.
lines.zh: : 我连正经教育都没受过，这我都知道。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, the Yakuza are more than just-
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，山口组可不只是——

lines.en: : Ahh, fuck it. What’s even the point?
lines.zh: : 唉，去他的。争这个有什么意义？

lines.en: scene tsuneysecondramen7
: The curse appears again...
lines.zh: : 那个咒又出现了……

lines.en: : Didn’t you learn that “Fuck” isn’t an {i}actual{/i} curse, though?
lines.zh: : 你不是已经知道「操」不是{i}真正{/i}的咒了吗？

lines.en: : That does not make it any less intimidating.
lines.zh: : 那也没让它少吓人一点。

lines.en: : If I told you the knife I am holding is plastic, you would still fear it, wouldn’t you?
lines.zh: : 如果我告诉你我手里这把刀是塑料的，你还是会怕它，对吧？

lines.en: : ...Not really. No.
lines.zh: : ……不太会。不会。

lines.en: : Even if you are some sort of Kendo god, I don’t think you’d have it in you to actually kill someone.
lines.zh: : 就算你是什么剑道之神，我也不觉得你真下得了手杀人。

lines.en: scene tsuneysecondramen1
: Would you?
lines.zh: : 你呢？

lines.en: : Kill someone?
lines.zh: : 杀人？

lines.en: : Yes. Would you be able to take the life of another person? And if so, why?
lines.zh: : 对。你能夺走另一个人的生命吗？如果能，为什么？

lines.en: : You’re not an undercover cop or anything, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会是卧底警察什么的吧？

lines.en: scene tsuneysecondramen2
: If I am, I’m a very bad one.
lines.zh: : 如果是，那我也是个很差的卧底。

lines.en: : I haven’t shown up to work in years...
lines.zh: : 我已经好几年没去上过班了……

lines.en: Huh...
Would I actually be able to kill someone?
lines.zh: 我真能下手杀人吗？

lines.en: I mean...Maybe? I haven’t ever really put much thought into it before.
lines.zh: 我是说……也许吧？我以前从没认真想过。

lines.en: There would have to be a good reason for it and-
lines.zh: 总得有个充分的理由，而且——

lines.en: Wait, why are we talking about something like this in a ramen shop?
lines.zh: 等等，我们为什么在一家拉面店里聊这个？

lines.en: : I have no idea. And I don’t really have any plans to figure that out any time soon.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。而且我短期内也没打算去弄明白。

lines.en: : Good. I no longer have to fear for my life.
lines.zh: : 很好。我不用再担心自己的性命了。

lines.en: : Praise be.
lines.zh: : 赞美。

lines.en: : Praise be.
lines.zh: : 赞美。

lines.en: scene tsuneysecondramen5
: Heheh...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……

lines.en: : Wait, why do you keep saying that and why do I just repeat it like it’s some sort of reflex?
lines.zh: : 等等，你为什么老说这个，而我为什么像条件反射一样跟着说？

lines.en: : I don’t know. But it’s funny, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 不知道。不过挺好笑的，不是吗？

lines.en: scene tsuneysecondramen8
: Much funnier than my actual jokes, anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正比我真正的笑话好笑多了。

lines.en: : I’m fully aware that those are not what they should be yet.
lines.zh: : 我完全清楚那些笑话还不达标。

lines.en: : But just as a marinating-egg, they will get better in time. And Tsuneyo Tojo will go on to be more than a mysterious noodle-woman.
lines.zh: : 但就像腌蛋一样，它们会随时间变得更好。而 Tsuneyo Tojo 终将不只是一个神秘的面条女人。

lines.en: For a moment, I ponder if whether this whole comedy thing is something Tsuneyo is actually interested in or if it’s just a way for her to get her personality across better.
lines.zh: 有那么一瞬间，我在想，这整套喜剧到底是 Tsuneyo 真正感兴趣的事，还是只是她表达个性的一种方式。

lines.en: The truth is, I’m kind of hoping that she doesn’t get any better if it’s the former.
lines.zh: 说实话，如果是前者，我倒有点希望她别进步。

lines.en: Is it wrong of me to want to hold back the dreams of someone else for my own personal benefit?
lines.zh: 为了自己的私心去拖别人梦想的后腿，这很过分吗？

lines.en: Change is a terrifying thing when it affects those around us.
lines.zh: 当改变发生在我们身边的人身上时，它是一件可怕的事。

lines.en: And even if Tsuneyo is a bit of a blank slate when it comes to personality, I think that’s what makes her {i}her{/i}.
lines.zh: 而即便 Tsuneyo 在个性上有点像一张白纸，我觉得那正是让她成为「{i}她{/i}」的东西。

lines.en: {s}And if I need to be the one to prevent her from changing, I will give up my arms for it.{/s}
lines.zh: {s}而如果必须由我来阻止她改变，我愿意为此献出双臂。{/s}

lines.en: scene tsuneysecondramen1
: You are taking much longer to decide than normal today.
lines.zh: : 你今天决定得比平常慢多了。

lines.en: : Would you like an explanation of the menu?
lines.zh: : 需要我介绍一下菜单吗？

lines.en: : It doesn’t take a rocket scientist to figure out how a menu works, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 看懂菜单又不需要火箭科学家，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: scene tsuneysecondramen9
: Ah-
: Oh, there it is again.
lines.zh: : 哦，又来了。

lines.en: : I guess you’re not getting comfortable around me after all.
lines.zh: : 看来你终究没有跟我在一起变得自在。

lines.en: scene tsuneysecondramen1
: I am not allowed to get comfortable around men.
lines.zh: : 我不被允许在男人面前自在。

lines.en: : All I can do is serve them food and hope that they will stay several feet away from me so I don’t get pregnant.
lines.zh: : 我只能给他们上菜，并祈祷他们离我几英尺远，好让我不会怀孕。

lines.en: : It takes a little more than that to get someone pregnant.
lines.zh: : 让人怀孕可不止需要那样。

lines.en: : You’d be surprised in today’s society.
lines.zh: : 在当今社会，你会惊讶的。

lines.en: : What do you know about society, Tsuneyo? You didn’t even start going to[school] until recently.
lines.zh: : 你懂什么社会，Tsuneyo？你不是最近才开始去[school]吗？

lines.en: : I’ve learned much from the people who sit on the opposite side of the counter.
lines.zh: : 我从坐在柜台另一边的人身上学到了很多。

lines.en: : One of the many, {i}many{/i} wonderful things about ramen shops are the conversations to be shared between perfect strangers in between the slurps of pork broth.
lines.zh: : 拉面店{i}众多{/i}美妙之处之一，就是陌生人之间在吸溜猪骨汤的间隙里分享的那些对话。

lines.en: scene tsuneysecondramen2
: “How was your day? What did you see on the way here? Are your children well?”
lines.zh: : 「今天过得怎么样？来的路上看到了什么？孩子们还好吗？」

lines.en: : This is more than just a home for me and my father. It’s a home for anyone who has 700 yen and a little bit of time to spare.
lines.zh: : 对我和父亲来说，这里不只是一个家。对任何有 700 日元和一点空闲时间的人来说，它都是家。

lines.en: : So to say I don’t understand society because of my homeschooling just isn’t true.
lines.zh: : 所以，说因为我是在家自学的就不懂社会，这并不成立。

lines.en: : There is more here than you would believe, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这里的东西比你以为的多得多，Sensei。

lines.en: For the first time ever, Tsuneyo breaks into a well-spoken tangent that goes on to show just how much she {i}does{/i} care about this place.
lines.zh: 有生以来第一次，Tsuneyo 说出了一段条理分明的长篇，展现出她有多在乎这个地方。

lines.en: It becomes clear that the whole noodle thing isn’t just a running gag...And that she isn’t being forced into carrying on her father’s business just because she was born into it.
lines.zh: 显而易见，面条这件事不只是一个反复出现的梗……她也不是因为生在这家才被迫继承父业。

lines.en: She...was raised by noodles.
lines.zh: 她……是被面条养大的。

lines.en: scene tsuneysecondramen1
: You have a strange look on your face again.
lines.zh: : 你脸上又出现了那种奇怪的表情。

lines.en: : ...Yeah.
: I just thought of a really weird sentence.
lines.zh: : 我刚刚想到了一句很怪的话。

lines.en: : I’ll have the Green Dragon again, please.
lines.zh: : 我还是要绿龙，谢谢。

lines.en: scene tsuneysecondramen5
: Of course. One Green Dragon.
lines.zh: : 当然。一份绿龙。

lines.en: : I will be right back. Please do not rob the cash register while I am preparing your food.
lines.zh: : 我马上回来。我做菜的时候，请不要抢劫收银机。

lines.en: : I didn’t plan on it...
lines.zh: : 我本来也没打算……

lines.en: scene tsuneysecondramen10
Tsuneyo disappears into the kitchen the same way she always does when I order.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 像往常一样，在我点单后消失进厨房。

lines.en: And I hear the same sounds I always do as she puts her all into making sure everything comes out perfectly.
lines.zh: 我也听到了和往常一样的声音——她倾尽所有，确保一切完美。

lines.en: You know-
lines.zh: 你知道吗——

lines.en: Maybe places like this really {i}are{/i} more than they appear to be on the outside.
lines.zh: 也许这样的地方{i}真的{/i}比它外表看起来的要丰富。

lines.en: And even in this horrible part of town-
lines.zh: 而即便在这座城镇最糟糕的角落——

lines.en: Somewhere good exists.
